name: Korum Winter Cube Challenge 2025

venue.name: Korum Mall, Thane
venue.address: Korum Mall, Eastern Express Hwy, Samata Nagar, Thane West, Thane, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400606

information:
1. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the New Competitor Information tab before registering.
2. All competitors should be familiar with the information in all the tabs & the extra registration requirements section.
3. Participants have to carry their own puzzles (cubes)
4. Every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
5. Make sure you are available at the venue at least 15-20 minutes prior to your respective event's start time.
6. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late.
7. No exceptions will be made unless discussed with the WCA Delegate in advance (contact us via the "Contact Us" tab)
8. The final decision and rights to accept/deny the exeception request remains with the WCA Delegate.
9.If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification.
